2026-27.position_proxy: Position labels supplied on history rows by the captured current snapshot; no roster-club/availability fields are used.

player_source_metadata.membership_method: Native fixture-side opponent IDs, independent raw fixture table where present, and exact E0 calendar/venue identity; no player's snapshot club is read.
player_source_metadata.early_missing_team_names_method: Unique intersection of full-season calendar/venue signatures and unique known-side fixture propagation; unresolved identities quarantined, no scores/fuzzy dates.
player_source_metadata.position_method: Historical GW position preferred; id/element_type season snapshot fallback only. Current-snapshot role labels remain explicit proxies with unverified historical publication time.
player_source_metadata.player_identity: season + element; no cross-season ID/name matching

feature_metadata.window_definition: Last5/10 same-season fixture-calendar slots strictly before the target printed calendar date; average available source fixtures, never fill a missing fixture's performance with zero.
feature_metadata.xi_definition: Fixed1GK4DEF4MID2FWD from prior-positive-appearance pool in last5slots; rank own-club observed minutes descending then element string ascending; remove players whose latest earlier positive appearance was at another club; no alternative-role backfill.
feature_metadata.xi_rate_definition: 90 * sum selected players' observed historical statistic / sum their observed historical minutes; weighted per-player-90 profile, not a predicted11-player match total.
feature_metadata.minute_mean_definition: Selected total prior minutes / selected players / observed club fixtures in last5slots.
feature_metadata.continuity_definition: Share of positive-minute players in the last observed fixture also positive in the preceding observed fixture; unknown with fewer than2observed fixtures.
limitations: Retrospectively saved fields and revisions have unverified historical publication times.
A positive-appearance pool cannot establish transfers without a later observed appearance, injuries, eligibility or actual availability.
FPL position labels may be season/current snapshot proxies; each selected role is taken only from a strictly earlier history row, and provenance is retained.
Same-season identity resets create missing/limited features early in each season and for newly observed players.
Scoring rules change across seasons. Native xG, starts, current roster, price, ownership and availability fields are excluded from these primary features.
Current club cohort target selection and all previously inspected seasons make subsequent model comparisons exploratory.
